us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Trump and Rubio to visit Venezuelan crude tanker in Texas
bullets: Trump and Marco Rubio planned to inspect a tanker carrying Venezuelan crude.
The crude is expected to be processed at Texas refineries.
Officials framed the visit around energy and Venezuela policy.

articles.title: Federal Reserve begins October policy meeting amid rate-watch focus
bullets: Fed policymakers opened a two-day meeting ending Wednesday.
Markets widely expected the central bank to hold rates steady.
Chair Kevin Warsh faces questions about Fed independence.

articles.title: Trump administration asks Washington state to set aside 400-plus ballots
bullets: Federal officials alleged more than 400 registrants may be noncitizens.
Washington was asked to segregate any ballots received from them.
State election scrutiny has intensified before the midterms.

articles.title: Trump administration seeks renewed prosecution of James Comey
bullets: Prosecutors revived allegations tied to a decade-old classified leak.
Comey’s lawyers called the effort legally invalid and time-barred.
The filing concerns a 2016 New York Times story involving Yahoo.

articles.title: Trump campaigns in Mississippi as GOP midterm concerns grow
bullets: Trump rallied in Mississippi late Monday for Republican candidates.
The stop underscored GOP worries in a reliably red state.
Midterm elections are scheduled for November 3.

global.label: Global
global.subtitle: Major worldwide stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Israel votes in high-stakes general election
bullets: Polls opened Tuesday in Israel’s general election.
Benjamin Netanyahu’s wartime leadership was central to the campaign.
Trump urged Israeli voters to return Netanyahu to power.

articles.title: Serbia students rally after Vucic election defeat
bullets: Students rallied in Belgrade after Aleksandar Vucic’s defeat.
AP listed the celebrations among Tuesday’s top global stories.
The vote marked a major political shift in Serbia.

articles.title: Brazil’s left-wing leader wins surprise election victory
bullets: Brazil’s election result returned a left-wing leader to power.
Economic Times listed the result among key international headlines.
The outcome drew global attention after a closely watched race.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine begin local ceasefire in frontline city
bullets: Russia and Ukraine began a local ceasefire in a frontline city.
Financial Times reported the development early Tuesday.
The pause comes amid continuing wider fighting.

articles.title: Fire breaks out in Seoul shantytown near Gangnam
bullets: A fire broke out in a shantytown in Seoul’s Gangnam district.
Reuters reported the blaze Tuesday morning.
Authorities responded in one of Seoul’s most prominent districts.

india.label: India News
india.subtitle: Top India stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Modi warns leaders about cyber terrorism risk
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi warned about cyber terrorism threats.
The warning was highlighted among major October 27 national headlines.
Cybersecurity remained a prominent government concern.

articles.title: India issues cyclone alert for eastern coast
bullets: Authorities warned of a potential cyclone affecting India’s eastern coast.
The alert featured among major national updates for October 27.
Coastal preparedness was emphasized as conditions developed.

articles.title: Indian Army rejects claims of Chinese control in Arunachal Pradesh
bullets: The Army refuted claims about Chinese control in Arunachal Pradesh.
The denial was listed among top India headlines.
Border messaging remained sensitive amid India-China tensions.

articles.title: Indian publishers challenge Modi government privacy law
bullets: Publishers linked to Ambani and Adani outlets joined the challenge.
The petition argues the law threatens journalistic confidentiality.
Reuters reported the case was filed in October.

articles.title: Oil prices and Fed decision pressure Indian rupee and bonds
bullets: Reuters said oil prices and the Fed decision would steer markets.
India’s external-finance concerns continued weighing on the rupee.
Domestic liquidity conditions added pressure to government bonds.

articles.title: AI-led rebound lifts Wall Street indexes
bullets: U.S. stocks rose Monday after a shaky global session.
AI-linked shares helped lead the rebound.
Investors remained cautious about funding costs for data centers.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO filing buoys AI stocks
bullets: Reuters reported equities ended higher after Anthropic filed to go public.
The filing supported sentiment toward AI-linked names.
The potential listing could be one of the biggest IPOs ever.

articles.title: SoFi shares jump after earnings and stronger guidance
bullets: MarketWatch reported SoFi stock was soaring after earnings.
IBD said the fintech raised its 2026 revenue guidance.
The move made SoFi a notable market mover Tuesday.

articles.title: Boeing falls after production challenges weigh on results
bullets: Reuters reported Boeing’s jetliner production issues hit third-quarter results.
Investor’s Business Daily said Boeing tumbled after an earnings miss.
Commercial-aircraft execution remained a key concern.

articles.title: Coca-Cola raises profit forecast on international demand
bullets: Reuters reported Coca-Cola lifted its profit forecast Tuesday.
International soda demand remained firm.
The update put Coca-Cola among major earnings movers.

articles.title: GM moves stock listing to Nasdaq
bullets: GM will move its listing from the NYSE to Nasdaq.
Reuters called it the first legacy automaker on the exchange.
Bloomberg also reported the listing shift Tuesday.

articles.title: DoorDash reportedly in talks to buy Instacart
bullets: Reuters reported DoorDash is discussing an Instacart acquisition.
The potential deal was valued around $17 billion.
Fast Company said DoorDash shares reacted to the report.

articles.title: Universal Music reportedly discussed going private
bullets: Bloomberg reported UMG discussed a take-private deal with buyout firms.
Reuters carried the report Monday.
The talks involved major private-equity interest.

articles.title: Merck drug extends survival in endometrial cancer trial
bullets: Reuters reported positive survival data for a Merck cancer drug.
The treatment also won U.S. priority review.
The update strengthened Merck’s oncology pipeline news.

articles.title: HSBC books $1.1 billion provision tied to Madoff litigation
bullets: HSBC said it would record a $1.1 billion provision.
The charge follows a partial loss in a Madoff-related appeal.
The provision will appear in third-quarter results.

articles.title: Anthropic files papers for first public share sale
bullets: Anthropic filed papers Monday for an initial public offering.
AP said the debut could happen next month.
The IPO could be among the largest ever stock sales.

articles.title: Tech companies seek religious guidance on ethical AI
bullets: AP reported AI firms are consulting religious leaders.
Companies are seeking broader input on moral AI questions.
Some scholars warn religion is not simply a rulebook.

articles.title: US-China AI blocs force countries into tougher choices
bullets: AP reported countries face pressure between U.S. and Chinese AI blocs.
The rivalry affects standards, supply chains and partnerships.
Experts say neutrality is becoming harder to maintain.

articles.title: Apple to replace iPhone Duo units with screen problems
bullets: Reuters reported Apple will replace affected iPhone Duo units.
The issue involves screen problems on some devices.
The replacement plan follows customer reports.

articles.title: Intel to buy quantum startup Classiq for about $2.3 billion
bullets: Bloomberg reported Intel agreed to buy Classiq.
The deal values the quantum startup at about $2.3 billion.
Globes separately reported Intel’s purchase of the Israeli company.
